description: The 3D bar chart visualizes the accuracy of different large language models—Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD—across two task types: Classification and Generation, with accuracy values ranging from 0.0 to 0.8. The horizontal axis represents the task type, with "Classification" and "Generation" labeled at the respective ends, while the vertical axis indicates accuracy. The depth axis distinguishes between the models, with Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD positioned along this axis. Each bar is color-coded using a gradient from blue to yellow, likely representing the magnitude of accuracy, with taller bars indicating higher performance. Davinci-003 achieves the highest accuracy in both task types, with its bar reaching approximately 0.8 for Classification and around 0.6 for Generation. ChatGPT shows moderate accuracy, with values around 0.5 for Classification and 0.3 for Generation. BARD has the lowest accuracy, with bars reaching approximately 0.4 for Classification and 0.2 for Generation. The chart clearly illustrates that Davinci-003 outperforms the other models across both tasks, while BARD consistently performs the worst.
